name: RIYADH CEMENT

audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (17 files in inventory). RIYADH CEMENT is Riyadh Cement Company on every cover.
audit.method: All 17 files opened (cover, contact sheet or statement pages). Fourteen statement filings had BS, IS and CF read: image statements rendered and read by eye (FY2022 BS only, all of FY2023-FY2025, Q1 2024 to H1 2026), FY2022 income statement and cash flow and H1 2022 income statement and cash flow from the text layer; H1 2023 BS only. Three earnings releases were identified from covers and headline text. tools/check_transcripts.py passes for transcripts/3092.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR whole. BS totals, income statement through net profit and EPS and cash flow (CFO/CFI/CFF/net change/opening/closing cash) transcribed from pages for FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, H1 2022, Q1/H1/9M 2024, Q1/H1/9M 2025 and Q1/H1 2026 (14 filings; H1 2023 balance sheet only). Every identity passes (BS equation, CF sum and roll, gross profit, five quarter-sum chains for revenue, gross profit and net profit). 18 cross-filing differences are declared with both values and filings: (1) FY2025 re-presents FY2024 operating profit as 292,936,394 vs 296,786,469 (other income 3,850,075 moved below operating profit) and CFO/CFI by 785,416 (finance income received 3,211,260 shown against investing); (2) the 2025 filings re-present the Q1, H1 and 9M 2024 operating profit and cash flow in the same way (e.g. 9M 2024 CFO 269,940,194 vs 270,162,156); (3) Dec 2021 balance sheet restated in FY2022 (total assets 1,887,793,433 vs 1,891,675,998, equity 1,662,080,263 vs 1,671,186,514, Note 26); (4) H1 2025 EPS 1.10 vs 1.11 in the H1 2026 comparative. Net profit and revenue never differ between filings for any period read. The 360,000,000 statutory reserve was released to retained earnings during H1 2026.

document_completeness.summary: Of 17 files, 14 hold complete BS, IS, equity and CF seen on pages (13 image-statement sets, FY2022 and H1 2022 with an image BS and text others), 1 (ac852728, H1 2023) is a legible full scan of which only the BS was read, and 3 are not statements: 7a7feda7 (9M 2025 earnings report), ed06f1b1 (FY2025 results announcement) and c2493c65 (Q1 2026 earnings release image). Inventory classes partial_statements, other_no_statements_found and scanned_unreadable are wrong for 10 statement files because the statement pages are images inside text PDFs or legible scans. The inventory also counts 7a7feda7 as financial_statements, which it is not. Annual statement files carry the publication year as fiscal_year.
